learning_outcomes.text: Consolidating knowledge in the field of Dynamics and understanding the relationship between Dynamics and other general technical disciplines.
Assimilation of basic knowledge applicable in the development of other specialized disciplines.
Developing the capacity to solve fundamental elementary mechanical engineering problems.

syllabus_topics: Dynamics of systems of material points and rigid bodies

assessment_methods.method: Written exam: 2 theoretical subjects and 2 problems
Applied activities (tests for solving assigned problems)

assessment_rules: The minimum performance standard for passing the course is solving and correctly addressing at least half of each proposed subject in the evaluation.
bibliography: Gheorghe Luca, Cosmina Vigaru, ramona Nagy, Mecanica. Dinamica, Ed. Politehnica Timisoara, 2007
